summary: ChatGPT CDP, Project Source transport, and profile-runtime routing belong in ops-cdp-core. Deprecated flakes and cdp proof trees are migration evidence or temporary runtime evidence, not a second canonical route.

Generic ChatGPT auth, a reachable CDP port, a stale profile, or a deprecated/raw script path can look successful while the target Project URL still redirects to login or cannot read Project Source. Profile resolution must prove the target Project route itself.

The normal Project transport route should be ops-cdp-core project-transport wrappers: probe the requested Project URL, upload to Project Source, verify visibility/readback, create or read the target Project thread with short pointer text, and keep semanticApproval/completionApproval/routeDecision false.

project-transport-doctor and project-transport-env now accept target Project URLs. Offline/generic/runtime-only checks do not become Project route success; no reachable CDP port fails; project-access probe is the required route gate for profile resolution.

The candidate Project profile gate was proven against the real ops-merge ChatGPT Project: target Project access was project-access-ok, Project Source upload was visible, a Project thread was created, and after at least 300 seconds the assistant returned the token that existed only in the uploaded Project Source file.

A fresh unauthenticated CDP profile on a reachable port did not become a Project route. Doctor reported unauthenticated with NO_AUTH_SESSION_COOKIE and no recommendedRoute. This guards against false positives where CDP is reachable but the target Project is not accessible.
